text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин is overcome with
emotion
following her debut race,
having taken a step
toward conquering
the Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Winning the race would honor her
grandparents
and earn her accolades as
a stayer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She stirs with motivation, ready to
further
improve her skills with the time
she has remaining
until spring.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
